# Alan Aziz Review

> Alan Aziz (@alanazizreview on Instagram & TikTok) is a Kuala Lumpur tech and gadgets creator. He makes hands-on reviews and tests of creator gear such as mics, lights, cameras and phones. Opinions come from his own use; brands can check facts and specs, the verdict stays his.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alanaziz.com/): who Alan is, brands he has reviewed, and the contact form
- [Newsroom](https://alanaziz.com/newsroom/): tech news write-ups
- [My Gear](https://alanaziz.com/gear/): the gear Alan shoots with

## Brands

- [Media kit request](https://alanaziz.com/#contact): submit the form to receive a 14-day link to the full media kit and rate card by email
